changelog: The sales calendar gets a "Me / Team" toggle (#3778): the Team view (`GET /api/sales/calendar/team`) adds colleagues' meetings — with the owner's initials and the lead's name, opening the colleague's lead page read-only, never the meeting title or a follow-up note — offered only when the shared team-read rule (`salesTeamReadAllowed`) lets the viewer read the org's book. A colleague's follow-up day is listed only for a viewer `canSeeNextAction` allows (an admin), never its note.

en: The sales calendar has a Team view: your colleagues' meetings appear read-only, with their initials.
tr: Satış takviminde artık Ekip görünümü var: ekip arkadaşlarının toplantıları baş harfleriyle, salt okunur görünüyor.
de: Der Vertriebskalender hat eine Team-Ansicht: Die Termine deiner Kolleg:innen erscheinen schreibgeschützt mit ihren Initialen.
